name: cheese-plugins
description: Personal agent plugin workspace. Same plugins served to both Codex (.agents/plugins/marketplace.json) and Claude Code (this file); skills are shared.

plugins.name: cheese-core
plugins.description: Core personal reasoning skills for cheese-plugins.

plugins.name: financial-analysis
plugins.description: Core financial modeling and analysis tools: DCF, comps, LBO, 3-statement models, competitive analysis, and deck QC. Adapted from Anthropic FSI.

plugins.name: equity-research
plugins.description: Equity research tools: earnings analysis, initiating coverage, idea generation, catalysts, thesis tracking, and research workflows. Adapted from Anthropic FSI.

plugins.name: serenity-skill
plugins.description: Serenity-inspired supply-chain bottleneck research for investment themes, stock screening, and thesis challenges.

plugins.name: goal-meta-skill
plugins.description: Turn vague or complex tasks into strong, copy-ready /goal commands with verification, constraints, boundaries, iteration policy, and pause conditions.

plugins.name: zrec-debug
plugins.description: zrec-model 远程调试闭环：本地改 → git 同步 → 远程服务器跑 ./run.sh → 报错回本地改再重测。SSH host 默认读 ssh config 里的 v11_x2，未配置则让用户输入；可选传入 debug 信息和 IP。
